mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points over three months signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% year-over-year signals strong economic demand, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings and consumer confidence rise.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when real GDP increases by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when industrial production increases by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points within the same month, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when retail and food services sales decrease by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% month-over-month signals a strengthening housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer confidence and related economic activity improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when housing starts increase by more than 5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure in a high-interest-rate environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as real returns are eroded.
regime_hint: inflationary period with high interest rates
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when both conditions are met.
